reason: Triumph Labs is a San Francisco real-money MOBILE skill-gaming platform and monetization SDK (~47-59 people, $10.2M Series A led by General Catalyst, later Series B per PitchBook), not a PC/console game studio entering full production - there is no publisher relationship, no Steam production milestone, and no Tech Director, so Ben's operative niche and its EDP (runway burned against a publisher-fixed milestone date) have no purchase here; the Infrastructure Engineer req does confess a real ops-ownership gap ('our infrastructure has been built and maintained by the core engineering team alongside everything else'), but they are solving it with a full-time first infra IC plus an Engineering Manager on fresh Series B capital, and pitching them would require abandoning Ben's game-studio positioning for his retired broad regulated-SaaS framing.
